content: Common Voice BIBREF10 is a crowdsourcing speech recognition corpus with an open CC0 license. Contributors record voice clips by reading from a bank of donated sentences. Each voice clip was validated by at least two other users. Most of the sentences are covered by multiple speakers, with potentially different genders, age groups or accents.
